notes: Points and miles expiry rules for common U.S. loyalty programs. 'inactivity' means the balance is forfeited after the stated months with no qualifying earn or redeem activity. Programs change rules; each entry links to the program page and carries a confidence rating.

programs.name: AAdvantage

expiry.detail: Miles expire after 24 months without earning or redeeming. Members under 21 are exempt.

keeps_alive: Spend on an AAdvantage credit card

expiry.detail: SkyMiles do not expire.
MileagePlus miles do not expire.
Rapid Rewards points do not expire.
TrueBlue points do not expire.

programs.name: Atmos Rewards

expiry.detail: Atmos Rewards points do not expire while the account stays open; accounts with no activity for an extended period can be closed.

keeps_alive: Any earn or redeem keeps the account active

programs.name: Free Spirit

expiry.detail: Points expire after 12 months without earning activity.

keeps_alive: Spend on the Free Spirit credit card

programs.name: FRONTIER Miles

expiry.detail: Miles expire after 12 months without earning activity; elite members and cardholders are exempt.

keeps_alive: Spend on the Frontier credit card

programs.name: Aeroplan

expiry.detail: Points expire after 18 months without earning or redeeming.

keeps_alive: Spend on an Aeroplan credit card

programs.name: Avios (The British Airways Club)

expiry.detail: Avios expire after 36 months without earning or redeeming.

keeps_alive: Any earn or redeem, including a 1 Avios transfer between Avios programs

programs.name: Flying Blue

expiry.detail: Miles expire after 24 months without a qualifying flight; earning miles with partners (including credit card transfers) extends validity.

keeps_alive: Any Air France or KLM flight

programs.name: LifeMiles

expiry.detail: Miles expire after 12 months without earning activity (24 months for cardholders).

keeps_alive: Any earn, including buying miles or partner transfers

expiry.detail: Points expire after 36 months without earning or redeeming.

programs.name: Emirates Skywards

expiry.detail: Miles expire three years after they were earned, at the end of the member's birthday month.

keeps_alive: Nothing extends them; redeem before expiry

programs.name: Marriott Bonvoy

expiry.detail: Points expire after 24 months without earning or redeeming.

keeps_alive: Spend on a Bonvoy credit card

programs.name: Hilton Honors

expiry.detail: Points expire after 24 months without earning or redeeming, unless you hold a Hilton Honors credit card.

keeps_alive: Holding or spending on a Hilton Honors card

programs.name: World of Hyatt

expiry.detail: Points expire after 24 months without earning or redeeming.

keeps_alive: Spend on the World of Hyatt card

expiry.detail: Points expire after 12 months without earning or redeeming; elite members and cardholders are exempt.
Points expire after 18 months of inactivity, and in any case four years after they were earned.
Points expire after 18 months without earning or redeeming.

programs.name: Membership Rewards

expiry.detail: Points do not expire while you hold an eligible card; closing all eligible cards forfeits the balance.

keeps_alive: Keep at least one Membership Rewards card open

programs.name: Ultimate Rewards

expiry.detail: Points do not expire while the account is open; closing the card forfeits unredeemed points.

keeps_alive: Keep the card open, or move points to another Ultimate Rewards card before closing

expiry.detail: Miles do not expire while the account is open.
Points do not expire while the account is open. After closing a card you generally have 60 days to use or transfer the points.

programs.name: Starbucks Rewards

expiry.detail: Stars expire six months after the month in which they were earned.

keeps_alive: Nothing extends them; redeem before expiry

expiry.detail: Points are forfeited after 12 months without a purchase.
Points expire after 12 months without a purchase.
